thread:
Emma (product): quick design review request — attaching mock for the request drilldown: trace viewer + stacktrace pane + correlation-id header. moved the Export action into a bottom sheet for mobile, and made 'Download trace' the primary CTA instead of 'Export'. looking for accessibility, copy, and layout nits before i ship the canary. https://redwood.mock/trace-drilldown :eyes:
Sasha (design): looks nice overall. two immediate things: (1) Copy: i prefer 'Download trace (JSON)' to make format explicit — 'Export' feels vague. (2) Visual hierarchy: stack frames get lost when the callsite is long — suggest wrapping the file path and making the filename bold. also add a visual affordance for folded frames like a subtle divider. :a11y:
Chris (frontend): agree on explicit copy. regarding bottom-sheet export — on desktop that pattern feels floating and inconsistent with other console actions (e.g., 'Download logs' in the logs page is top-right). can we keep parity? If we move it, i'll need to coordinate the header layout. also keyboard: export action must be reachable with Tab and announce via aria-live when download starts. sample aria for the button: `aria-label="Download trace JSON"`
Omar (eng): implementation heads-up — full trace JSON can be big for long requests; we should stream the download or cap at 5MB and warn the user. for folding: prefer lazy-rendering of hidden frames so initial render stays fast. simple pseudocode for collapse state persistence: `localStorage.setItem('trace:collapse:v2', JSON.stringify({<traceId>: collapsedFrames}))`
Raj (ux research): quick usability note from session last week: people want to copy correlation IDs quickly. can we add a one-click copy chip next to the ID, and keep it sticky when you scroll the stack? observed users losing the id when switching tabs. small micro-copy tweak: 'Copy request ID' > 'Copy correlation ID' depending on audience.
Sasha (design): +1 to copy chip. accessibility: ensure focus ring is visible when you tab to the copy chip and add `role="status"` message on copy success for screen readers. color contrast: the folded-frame chevron is currently #6b7280 — failing AA at small sizes; bump to #374151.
design-bot: new design token `--shadow-elevation-2` deployed to staging for the bottom-sheet overlay (build #4297).
Chris (frontend): noted re: token. if we keep export in header, we can reuse existing header button component and avoid a11y regression. for the copy chip aria: `button[aria-label]=\"Copy correlation id\"` and on click `announce('Correlation id copied')` via `aria-live="polite"`. also will add a debounce on the download to avoid double clicks.
Omar (eng): for the JSON size cap — propose adding a server-side endpoint param `?format=trimmed` that prunes long request bodies and repeats. fallback: if size > 5MB show an inline modal: "Trace too large to download — download trimmed version or open in viewer."
Emma (product): great — plan: keep export in header for desktop, bottom-sheet only on mobile (follow logs page pattern). change CTA label to 'Download trace (JSON)' and add copy chip for correlation id sticky on scroll. Sasha — can you update mock with contrast change and sticky chip? Chris/Omar — i'll put a short tech spec in the ticket for streaming/trimmed download. Raj — can you add two quick usability checks in your next session? aiming to ship canary Wed. :thumbsup:
Sasha (design): will update mocks today and post updated PNGs in this thread. also adding a11y checklist: focus, contrast, live region.
Chris (frontend): i'll pick up header button changes and the aria announcements — PR will reference this thread.
Omar (eng): i'll prototype trimmed endpoint and lazy render.
Raj (ux research): will add two test scenarios and get back by Tue.
Emma (product): awesome — thanks everyone. ping me here when mocks are updated and i'll schedule canary. :rocket:
